design_principle: Color is decorative, never the sole carrier of meaning. Every semantic category below is redundantly coded by color + line-style + icon-shape, so the overlay is readable in grayscale, under any color-vision deficiency, and in bright outdoor sun-glare on a phone screen.
no_red_green_pass_fail_coding: The grammar deliberately avoids a red=bad/green=good pairing anywhere. Fault focus uses Focus Coral (not alarm red) with a pin/magnifying-glass icon, not an X or exclamation mark. Correction/target uses Target Violet, not green. This keeps the tone diagnostic and growth-oriented rather than pass/fail, which matters most for a 13-year-old's relationship to feedback.

structure_neutral.role: Body skeleton, reference axes, base of support — always-on low-key context. Never the focus of attention.

measured_fact_blue.role: Directly measured/high-confidence current-frame facts: contact point, ball trail, racket path, angle arcs when confidence.measurement >= 0.85.

cause_amber.role: CAUSE_ARROW and the phase/joint identified as root_cause_candidate.

correction_violet.role: CORRECTION_ARROW, RECOVERY_TARGET, TARGET_GHOST — where the player is moving toward, not a verdict on where they are now.

focus_coral.role: FAULT_PIN only — draws the eye to the one thing being discussed this moment. Deliberately not saturated alarm-red.

ghost_reference_white.role: TARGET_GHOST silhouette (player's own past-best or a generic reference silhouette — never a named professional's likeness).

system_chrome_slate.role: CONFIDENCE_BADGE and VISIBILITY_WARNING chip backgrounds (screen-space UI, not video-space).

confidence_rendering.rule: Confidence is rendered redundantly via opacity AND line-style AND an explicit badge — never inferred from color alone.

not_visible_or_unsupported.behavior: marker suppressed entirely from video-space; VISIBILITY_WARNING chip shown once in screen-space UI chrome, never drawn on top of the player as a broken/ghosted marker.

geometry.angle_arc_label_placement: outside the acute angle, 12px offset, always upright regardless of limb rotation

skeletal_kinematic.occlusion_behavior: If a keypoint's underlying pose-estimation confidence drops mid-clip (self-occlusion, motion blur), fade that segment's line to 0 opacity over 2 frames rather than snapping to a wrong position or jittering. Do not interpolate a straight line across an occluded joint.

geometry.path_trail_fade: linear opacity ramp from 0.9 (current frame) to 0 (8 frames back)

racket.note: RACKET_FACE_ESTIMATE is always rendered at medium/low confidence styling (monocular video cannot reliably measure face angle without a second view) unless camera_suitability marks racket_face != conditional for the active view.

geometry.contact_point_style: filled ring, 2x radius pulse on the freeze frame only
geometry.contact_window_style: bracket marks on the phase timeline, not drawn on the video frame

special_case_projected_ball_path.note: PROJECTED_BALL_PATH is a physics estimate, not a measurement — it always renders in the ghost/estimate style regardless of other confidence scores.

court_and_positioning.note: COURT_HOMOGRAPHY only renders when a calibration confidence threshold is met; below threshold it is suppressed rather than shown skewed.

geometry.arrow_curvature: quadratic bezier, control point offset perpendicular to the direct line so the arrow never crosses over the player's body or the ball

system_confidence.space: screen-space UI chrome, not video-space — always upright, fixed to viewport edge, never rotates or scales with the video content

responsive_scaling.rule: All line widths, radii, and font sizes are defined as a percentage of video width/diagonal, never fixed pixels, and are additionally floored at a minimum on-screen size (line_width floor 1.5px, joint_dot floor 4px, label text floor 12px at 100% font_scale) so nothing disappears on a small phone screen regardless of source video resolution.
